scheme_name: Scheme to Award Scholarship to Young Artists
other_conditions: Applicant must be a student studying in the final year of B.F.A. or M.F.A. at Government College of Fine Arts, Chennai or Government College of Fine Arts, Kumbakonam.
benefits_summary: Scholarships of ₹3,000 for up to 10 final‑year B.F.A. students and ₹5,000 for top M.F.A. students at the Government Colleges of Fine Arts, Chennai and Kumbakonam.
